q: 1. Five members are elected from Nepal Engineers Association members to represent in Nepal Engineering Council every:
explain: As per election tenure alignment, NEA representatives are elected every 2 years during regular organizational elections.

q: 2. In general, Nepal Engineering Council meeting per year should be held:
explain: Statutory requirements mandate that NEC must hold its council meetings at least 4 times per year.

q: 3. Engineering profession needs cooperation with the profession of:
explain: Comprehensive multidisciplinary projects require cross-functional cooperation across legal, financial, and safety/medical fields.

q: 4. The minimum qualification required for a general engineer is ........
explain: A bachelor's degree in engineering is the minimum for registration as a general engineer, per the answer key.

q: 5. The registered engineer in Nepal Engineering Council should have to renew their registration in:
explain: General Engineer registration under NEC Act is a lifetime registration and does not mandate periodic renewal (unlike foreign engineers).

q: 6. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in Engineer Council Rule, 2057 for Registration?
explain: The NEC Rule 2057 categories are General Registered, Professional, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer; 'Chartered Engineer' is not among these categories.

q: 7. The member secretary of NEC is ........
explain: The registrar serves as the member secretary of the council.

options: ministry of physical infrastructure and transport
explain: As per the answer key, NEC liaises with the government through the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 9. The numbers of chapters in NEC act 2055 are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 7 chapters.

q: 10. The number of NEA members nominated for NEC is ........
explain: As per the answer key, 5 NEA members are nominated to the council.

q: 11. Every practicing engineer in Nepal must be registered legally in:
explain: As per the answer key, every practicing engineer must be legally registered with the Nepal Engineer's Association.

q: 12. The function of Nepal Engineering Council is to:
options: register and issue license to engineers
Enforce engineering profession code of conduct
regulate the required standard of educational facilities of engineering colleges
explain: NEC's functions comprehensively include registering and licensing engineers, enforcing the code of conduct, and regulating educational standards for engineering colleges.

q: 13. The numbers of clause in Nepal engineering council act is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 38 clauses.

q: 14. Which is the professional body of architectural and engineering firms is Nepal?
options: Sociality of Consulting Engineering and Architectural firms
explain: SCAEF (Society of Consulting Architectural and Engineering Firms) represents private consulting firms in Nepal.

q: 15. Nepal engineering council is an autonomous body formed under act in
explain: NEC was formed as an autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act enacted in 2055 B.S.

q: 16. What is the provision in Engineer Council Act and Regulation in Nepal for the punishment if a person practices Engineering work without registering into the Nepal Engineering Council?
options: Rs 1000 find or imprisonment of 1 month or both
Rs3000 fine or Imprisonment of 3 month of both
explain: Section 31 of NEC Act provides a maximum fine of NRs 3,000 or up to 3 months imprisonment (or both) for unauthorized illegal practice.

q: 17. Provision for professional code of conduct of engineers in Nepal is made in detail in:
explain: The explicit operational code of conduct for registered engineers is detailed under the Nepal Engineering Council Rules/Regulations 2057.

q: 18. Any Non-Nepali Engineer desiring to work in Nepal may apply for registration under:
explain: Foreign national engineers practicing in Nepal are registered under Category C as defined by the council rules.

q: 19. The general experience required for nomination of chairperson of NEC is :
explain: The Chairperson of NEC must have at least 15 years of professional engineering experience following graduation.
